standard-dialogue.npc: Yes? Do you have business with one of the prisoners?

standard-dialogue.player: I don't think so. What are they in for?

standard-dialogue.npc: Does it matter? They are criminals.
They will be if they're found guilty.

standard-dialogue.player: Ah, nice. Bit brutal though, right?

Because she hasn't said a word since she arrived.
